meaning_en: The right to enter a place or join a group.
example_en: Admission to the museum is free.
examples_extra: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
He paid the admission and went inside.
note_fa: «حق ورود؛ admission free یعنی ورود رایگان.»

meaning_en: Burning brightly; on fire.
example_en: The old house was completely alight after the fire started.
examples_extra: Passengers must not alight while the bus is moving.
We alighted from the train at the last stop.
note_fa: رسمی و قدیمی؛ معادل get off از اتوبوس/قطار.

meaning_en: A large room where people watch performances.
example_en: The school auditorium can hold 500 students.
examples_extra: The new school auditorium can hold 500 people.
We waited in the auditorium before the play began.

meaning_en: To state something officially or publicly.
example_en: You must declare all goods at customs.
examples_extra: The president declared a national emergency yesterday.
Travellers must declare goods at customs.
note_fa: در گمرک declare یعنی اظهار کردن کالا؛ declare war یعنی اعلان جنگ.

meaning_en: To get off a horse, bicycle, or other vehicle.
example_en: Please dismount your bicycle before entering the park.
examples_extra: The rider dismounted from his horse at the gate.
She dismounted her bicycle and walked into the shop.
note_fa: پیاده شدن از اسب/دوچرخه؛ مقابل mount.

meaning_en: To show something publicly.
example_en: The museum will display ancient artifacts.
examples_extra: The shop displays its newest phones in the front window.
They displayed the children's paintings on the classroom wall.
note_fa: نمایش دادن؛ fireworks display یعنی «نمایش آتش‌بازی».

meaning_en: To interrupt someone or something.
example_en: Please do not disturb the sleeping baby.
examples_extra: I'm sorry to disturb you, but I need your help.
Please do not disturb the baby while she is sleeping.
note_fa: Do not disturb روی در هتل یعنی «مزاحم نشوید».

meaning_en: Do not leave your bags alone.
meaning_fa: کیف‌های خود را بدون مراقب رها نکنید
example_en: The airport sign said, 'Do not leave bags unattended'.
examples_extra: Please do not leave bags unattended at the airport.
The sign says: do not leave bags unattended in this area.
note_fa: اعلان امنیتی فرودگاه؛ unattended یعنی «بدون مراقب».

meaning_en: The act of going in or a place to go in.
example_en: No entry after 10 PM.
examples_extra: Entry to the museum is free on the first Sunday.
The guard checked our tickets at the entry gate.
note_fa: هم «ورود» هم «ورودی»؛ در دیکشنری یعنی مدخل.

meaning_en: To give food to a person or animal.
example_en: Please feed the cat before you leave.
examples_extra: We feed the chickens every morning.
She feeds her baby at noon.
note_fa: گذشته و اسم مفعولش fed است.

meaning_en: easily broken or damaged.
example_en: Be careful, the glass is fragile.
examples_extra: Be careful! The glass is fragile.
The old bridge looks fragile.

meaning_en: Official advice about dangers to health.
example_en: Cigarettes have a health warning on them.
examples_extra: All cigarette packs carry a strong health warning.
The government issued a health warning about the heat.

meaning_en: Happening now, not yet finished.
meaning_fa: در حال انجام، در دست اقدام
example_en: The building work is still in progress.
examples_extra: The road works are still in progress.
Exams are in progress, so please keep quiet.
note_fa: در حال انجام؛ work in progress.

meaning_en: To hurt yourself or someone else.
example_en: Be careful not to injure yourself.
examples_extra: Two players were injured in the match.
She badly injured her knee while skiing.

meaning_en: To stay away from something.
example_en: Please keep off the grass.
examples_extra: Please keep off the grass in the park.
Keep your hands off my phone!
note_fa: keep off = دور ماندن از چیزی.

meaning_en: To stay on the right or left side.
example_en: In the UK, drivers must keep left.
examples_extra: In Britain, you must keep left.
Keep right when you drive in France.

meaning_en: To bend or rest against something.
example_en: Don't lean on the wet paint.
examples_extra: He leaned against the wall and closed his eyes.
Do not lean too far out of the window.
note_fa: «تکیه دادن»؛ lean on یعنی «به چیزی تکیه کردن».

meaning_en: Rubbish left in a public place.
example_en: Please don't drop litter here.
examples_extra: Please do not drop litter in the park.
The streets were full of litter after the festival.

meaning_en: Be careful of the step.
example_en: The sign said, "Mind the step."
examples_extra: Mind the step as you come in.
There is a sign saying mind the step.
note_fa: یعنی «مواظب پله باش»؛ جملهٔ امری است.

meaning_en: Be careful not to hit your head.
example_en: Mind your head, the ceiling is low.
examples_extra: Mind your head on the low door.
Mind your head on the low ceiling!

meaning_en: Not important or serious.
example_en: It was a minor problem, easily fixed.
examples_extra: It's only a minor problem.
She had minor surgery last week.

meaning_en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
example_en: He rides his motorbike to work.
examples_extra: He rides his old motorbike to work daily.
She bought a cheap second-hand motorbike yesterday.

meaning_en: You cannot go into this place.
example_en: The sign says "No entry" here.
examples_extra: The sign said no entry, so we turned back.
There is a no entry sign at the end of the street.

meaning_en: There is no way out from this place.
example_en: We are stuck; there is no exit.
examples_extra: We drove into a street with no exit.
The map showed no exit from the car park.

meaning_en: You cannot park your car here.
example_en: Look, there's a "No parking" sign.
examples_extra: There is no parking near the station.
The no parking sign was clearly visible.

meaning_en: No rooms are available in this hotel.
example_en: The hotel sign said "No vacancies."
examples_extra: The hotel had no vacancies, so we tried another one.
A sign outside said no vacancies for tonight.
note_fa: اتاق خالی نداریم؛ روی تابلوی هتل.

meaning_en: A written or printed announcement.
example_en: There's a notice on the wall.
examples_extra: The school put up a notice about the trip.
Did you see the notice on the noticeboard?
note_fa: اطلاعیه کتبی؛ put up a notice یعنی «نصب کردن».

meaning_en: Not working correctly.
example_en: The lift is out of order.
examples_extra: The lift is out of order.
The cash machine is out of order today.

meaning_en: A punishment for breaking a rule or law.
example_en: There is a penalty for late payment.
examples_extra: The team got a penalty for the foul.
There is a penalty for late payment.

meaning_en: An official document allowing you to do something.
example_en: You need a permit to park here.
examples_extra: You need a permit to park here.
He applied for a work permit.

meaning_en: The people who work for an organization.
example_en: All personnel must wear ID badges.
examples_extra: The company has 200 personnel.
All company personnel must attend the meeting.

meaning_en: Not allowed; forbidden.
example_en: Smoking is strictly prohibited here.
examples_extra: Smoking is strictly prohibited here.
Parking is prohibited on this street.

meaning_en: To officially accuse someone of a crime.
example_en: The police decided to prosecute him.
examples_extra: They decided to prosecute the thief.
He was prosecuted for fraud.

meaning_en: stand in a line waiting for something
example_en: Please queue here for tickets.
examples_extra: We had to queue for tickets.
They queued outside the shop.

meaning_en: To make something smaller or less.
example_en: We need to reduce our waste.
examples_extra: We need to reduce the amount of sugar we eat.
The shop reduced all prices by twenty percent.
note_fa: کاهش دادن؛ reduce by یعنی «به میزان».

meaning_en: To stop yourself from doing something.
example_en: Please refrain from smoking in this area.
examples_extra: Please refrain from smoking in this area.
He could hardly refrain from laughing.

meaning_en: to spend time in prison as punishment
example_en: He had to serve five years in prison.
examples_extra: He served five years in prison.
She had to serve her sentence.
note_fa: serve a sentence یعنی محکومیت را گذراندن.

meaning_en: Complete absence of sound.
example_en: Please keep silence in the library.
examples_extra: An awkward silence filled the large, dark room.
They sat together in total silence for hours.

meaning_en: All tickets or items are gone.
example_en: The concert tickets are sold out.
examples_extra: The concert is sold out.
All tickets were sold out.

meaning_en: Someone who goes onto private land without permission.
example_en: A sign warned trespassers to stay off the property.
examples_extra: The guard caught a trespasser last night.
Trespassers will be prosecuted by law.
note_fa: متجاوز به ملک دیگران؛ تابلوی معروف: Trespassers will be prosecuted.

meaning_en: Not with another person or people.
example_en: Children under 12 must be accompanied.
examples_extra: Unaccompanied children need extra help.
She travelled completely unaccompanied last year.
note_fa: بدون همراه؛ unaccompanied minors یعنی کودکان تنها.

meaning_en: Not allowed by official permission.
example_en: Do not enter this area; it is unauthorised.
examples_extra: Unauthorised parking is not allowed.
No unauthorised personnel beyond this point.

meaning_en: a machine that transports people or goods
example_en: A car is a type of vehicle.
examples_extra: All vehicles must stop at the red light.
Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular.

meaning_en: A statement telling you about a possible danger.
example_en: The sign gave a warning about falling rocks.
examples_extra: The red sign gave a very clear warning.
He foolishly ignored the repeated warning signs.
